title: Microsoft Teams: change the background while recording a video clip on iPhone
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, admin route, PowerShell control and product-level licensing are supported. The control note unnecessarily questions whether video messages include clips; Microsoft's cited release notes explicitly describe clips as video messages. The background-specific default and meeting-policy applicability remain undocumented in the sources checked.
